summary: Iter-39 (email verification, EU region, brake-test gap, super-admin panel, staff role) fully verified. Backend pytest 21/21 PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter39_batch.py, 31s). Email verification: POST /api/auth/register with new email returns {needs_verification:true,email} and NO JWT; a plaintext token + bcrypt code_hash row is written to email_verifications; login pre-verify -> 403 email_not_verified; POST /api/auth/verify with token logs the user in (returns JWT) and sets users.email_verified=true; wrong-code path returns 400 and after 6 attempts returns 429; resend-verification returns {ok:true}; existing manager@haulcheck.co.uk still logs in without verification (grandfathered). Region EU: PUT /api/settings/region {region:'EU'} => 200 + /auth/me shows EU; invalid region => 400; /api/maintenance/costs returns currency '€' under EU; UI sidebar shows region-UK / region-IE / region-EU. Brake-test gap: fresh UK account with 1 vehicle & no PMI brake record => /api/ai/risk-insight checklist includes 'no laden roller brake test recorded' with priority 'high', and /api/dashboard.risk_score < 100; same setup under EU and IE does NOT emit the brake gap. Super-admin: GET /api/admin/users as manager@haulcheck.co.uk returns {users, stats{total,active,suspended,verified,unverified,by_region(UK/IE/EU),owners}} (113 users on admin page in UI); non-admin fresh user -> 403; /auth/me shows is_admin=true for admin, false for others; PUT /api/admin/users/{uid}/active toggles suspend/reactivate: suspended user login -> 403 'suspended' and their existing token -> 401 on /auth/me; PUT active:true restores login; admin cannot suspend self or another admin (traffic@dlz-international.com) -> 400 both. Staff role: POST /api/invitations {role:'staff'} creates invite with role staff; POST /api/auth/accept-invite creates user role='staff', email_verified=true, account_owner_id=inviter; staff GET /api/vehicles returns inviter's data and POST /api/vehicles succeeds (not blocked by viewer write-guard); viewer POST /api/vehicles => 403. Frontend Playwright: /login Register flow renders data-testid=verify-screen with verify-code-input, verify-submit-button, resend-code-button, verify-back-button; /verify-email?token=BAD&email=x renders verify-screen with error toast; admin sees nav-admin link + /admin page with admin-page, admin-stats, admin-search, and 113 admin-user-row rows; sidebar shows region-UK / region-IE / region-EU (3-way toggle); /team invite form shows role-manager / role-staff / role-viewer options. All test users, invitations, vehicles, and email_verifications rows were cleaned up; admin account region reset to UK (verified in DB).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5564 lines — still monolithic (auth, admin, region, invitations, gap-detection all inline). auth.py, admin.py and gaps.py modules would materially reduce risk.

resend-verification rate-limit compares ISO strings ((datetime.now(...) - 45s).isoformat()) — ISO comparison is fine here because both sides are timezone-aware, but a datetime comparison of created_at would be more defensive against timezone drift.

detect_gaps() re-queries 12 collections on every /ai/risk-insight and /dashboard call — no caching; on large tenants this is O(n) MongoDB round-trips per request. Consider caching per user_id for ~30s.

/api/auth/verify accepts EITHER token or code but attempts counter only increments on code path — a bot could burn the token attempt via token-guessing without ever hitting the 429 cap. Consider incrementing attempts on failed token comparison too, or shortening token TTL.
admin_list_users returns up to 5000 users unpaginated (find(...).to_list(5000)); should add cursor-based pagination and a hard cap.
POST /auth/register does not enforce password strength (any string accepted). Add min length + complexity check.
email_verifications collection has no TTL index — expired rows are only cleaned lazily on successful verify. Add a Mongo TTL index on expires_at.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids present, verify screen renders on register, bad verify link shows error, admin panel + region toggle + staff role option all render)
